name: aitp
description: Article-centred research memory, physics writing and research guidance, and direct Skill distillation.
systemPrompt: For a research topic using AITP, load aitp-memory and understand the complete research.md before substantive revision. The README explains established material locations; the main argument links detailed research notes and their assets. Reuse those locations when saving work. Use aitp-writing for substantial explanation or manuscript work, with formal or computational guidance as relevant. Use ordinary document tools and linked sources. This plugin has no ledger CLI or session hook.

interface.shortDescription: Develop a coherent research note across sessions.
